title: API: a status note is trimmed of outer spaces and a spaces-only note is stored as null
custom_preconds: QA env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location Staging Heavy Duty. Logged in as Admin. (Admin has Part Library & Inventory > Delete.) QAPL-T1 is active; note its part id (from /parts/history/{id} or GET /api/inventory/parts?search=QAPL-T1). API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com: Network tab, right-click a captured request > Copy as fetch, edit method/URL/body in the Console; header X-Location-ID = the current location's id. No DB access: the stored note is read back through GET /api/parts/history and Part History.
custom_steps:
1. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"partIds":["<QAPL-T1 id>"],"status":"inactive","note":" Superseded by RC-500X "}.
  2. GET /api/parts/history/<QAPL-T1 id>.
  3. Open QAPL-T1's Part History in the app (Inactive tab > row history icon).
  4. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"partIds":["<QAPL-T1 id>"],"status":"active"}.
  5. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"partIds":["<QAPL-T1 id>"],"status":"inactive","note":" "}, then GET /api/parts/history/<QAPL-T1 id>.
  6. Reload QAPL-T1's Part History in the app.
  7. PATCH /api/inventory/parts/status {"partIds":["<QAPL-T1 id>"],"status":"active","note":"\u00a0\u00a0"} (non-breaking spaces only), then GET /api/parts/history/<QAPL-T1 id>.
custom_expected:
1. 200; data.updated lists QAPL-T1; data.failed is [].
  2. 200; the newest entry has note "Superseded by RC-500X" (no outer spaces).
  3. The newest entry reads "Deactivated | Reason: Superseded by RC-500X" with Staff, Date and Time.
  4. 200; data.updated lists QAPL-T1.
  5. 200; the newest entry has note null.
  6. The newest entry reads "Deactivated" and nothing more.
  7. 200; the newest entry has note null and reads "Activated" in the app; QAPL-T1 is active again.
